title: Fishing With Salty
specs: Fishing inshore and nearshore up to 9 miles in Gulf of Mexico, bay, river, backcountry waterways
Targets include Cobia, Blacktip Shark, Grouper, Snapper, Flounder, Sheepshead, Redfish, Snook, Speckled Seatrout, Spanish Mackerel, Tarpon
Boat is 24' Triton LTS Pro with 250 HP engine, GPS, fishfinder, wireless trolling motor, speakers
Fly fishing, gigging, bowfishing, spearfishing require own gear and may be referred out

services.name: Meet Fishing
services.desc: I went Scouting with my buddy Chris, together we discovered a new adventure one that I plan to experience more often! Catching Snook and Trout beach fishing Florida from an Island! I think this would give Anglers, Fishermen, and Fly Fisherman alike to experience a secluded trip much like being in the Caribbean at a fraction of the price! You can book your trip with me to experience a trip just like this on my New Website www.FishingWithSalty.com we caught a number of species including Snook, Trout, Ladyfish and we saw plenty Redfish on this trip as well. I offer both: Private Charters and Shared Split Trips both for a fantastic time on the

blurb: Guests join Capt. Jonathan Soultatos for guided fishing trips inshore and nearshore around Anna Maria Island and Tampa Bay. Trips use a 24' Triton LTS Pro bay boat equipped with modern fishing gear and technology. The captain provides rods, reels, bait, and cleaning services, and offers photography and videography packages.
